Adds a Jojaman™ Statue to your game! Every Friday you can buy one at the JojaMart!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
We at Joja Corp always try to ensure full compatibility with our customers. Be sure that we put utmost care into the development of this statue of our dear mascot.
